reason: The independent Bishop–Gromov theorem concerns a Riemannian manifold, Ricci lower bound on a ball with compact closure, actual manifold/model ball volume ratios, limit one at zero and the nonnegative-Ricci corollary. These two roots instead concern arbitrary measurable nonnegative densities on a normed vector space and assume raywise ratio monotonicity directly; neither root links the density integral to Riemannian ball volume or derives the geometric monotonicity from Ricci curvature, and neither states the zero-radius limit.
